Every year, someone posts a list of multibagger penny stocks. I checked what happened to one of them.
A popular blog list. Best multibagger stocks under twenty rupees, for twenty twenty six. Ten names.
Yes Bank. Eighteen twenty eight on the list. Today, seventeen seventy three. JP Power, sixteen sixty seven to thirteen.
RattanIndia Power, twelve to six forty three. EaseMyTrip, fourteen to six thirty eight. Salasar Techno, thirteen to five twenty six.
Hathway, Orient Green, Brightcom, PC Jeweller. All lower. And Rama Steel Tubes, eleven ninety one to three ninety seven. Down sixty seven percent.
Ten out of ten are below the price on the list. Not one multibagger.
Ten thousand rupees in each, one lakh in total, is now worth about sixty three thousand eight hundred.
The lesson. A low share price is not a cheap company. Before any penny stock, check profits, debt, promoter pledge, and trading volume.
Next time you see a multibagger list, remember this one. Save it. Not a buy or sell call. Follow money in cloud.
